item.description:
# Ghostex 11.11.1
## 11.11.1 - 2026-11-19
**Ghostex 11.11.1 is out.** A calmer chat header, Grok Bot set up from Settings with no terminal and able to pass your answers on to your agents, CLIProxyAPI hubs as the place new sessions start with their usage in the sidebar, signed-out accounts shown in amber, Live pages, click-to-toggle Settings rows, and Workspaces fixes for remote projects.
### 💬 Chat
- **A calmer chat header:** it keeps the chat's and project's own controls (Start, Open, Commit, Work, the context ring and the panel toggles), and a ⋯ menu holds Grok Bot, Claude, Voice, Share and Open in a popup. Pin any of them from its ⋯ row and unpin it with a right-click; a control in use stays in the header while it is. - **Ghostex pages are now Live pages,** on the page card, in Settings > Chat > Open Live pages in, the Resources list and Help. Only the name changes. - **Opening a Live page that waits to be seen takes it out of the counts** (the bell, the sidebar dot, Needs you and the dock), and its dock row and Work card stay until you dismiss it or mark it seen. - **The chat box stays usable while a private secret card is open:** typing goes to the card until you click into the chat box, and text there that looks like a key or token needs a second Send. - **More commands get Copy and Paste in terminal:** a program Ghostex doesn't know counts when a flag or a path follows it, and a script run from here (`./run.sh build`) counts with any argument. A command too wide for its line is shortened from its start, so its end stays visible. - **A command in the floating ask panel's title or status line gets Copy and Paste in terminal too,** and Ctrl+Insert on Windows and Linux, or Ctrl+Shift+C on Linux, copies the panel's selection. - **Busy chats use far less power:** a fold animation whose row scrolled away no longer redraws the window every frame, and with Faster rendering off the Quiet View loader no longer lays out the chat 30 times a second.
### 🤖 Grok Bot
- **Set up Grok Bot from Settings > Grok Bot, with no terminal:** a checklist ticks off each step as Ghostex sees it, from finding the Grok Bot app and adding the published Ghostex bot to pasting its webhook and the test note. - **Grok Bot can pass your answers on to your agents:** `ghostex agents send --as-user` sends a message as you, and it ends with "Sent via Grok Bot" (or "Sent from the terminal") so you can tell where it came from. A message one agent sends another always names the agent that sent it. - **The two Grok extensions have clearer names:** Grok Bot Embed shows grok.com in the header, and Grok Bot Integration lets Grok Bot control Ghostex. Integration is on by default with its switch at the top of the Grok Bot page; turned off, your agents' notes wait until you turn it back on.
### 👤 Accounts
- **A CLIProxyAPI hub can be where new sessions start:** pick it in the New sessions start on rule in Settings > Accounts, or with `start-thread --account <hub>`. A session's automatic title, Generate Commit Message and Catch me up run on its hub too. - **Hub accounts get usage meters at the bottom of the sidebar,** with Show usage in the sidebar in each account's pane. A login that is also a Claude Swap or Codex Swap account shows once, and each account's usage is read at most every 15 minutes. - **`ghostex accounts hub list|add|update|remove` adds a hub from a terminal,** reading its keys only from a file or standard input. - **A hub that is down says so:** a session asked to start on it says why and to pick another account, one that only follows New sessions start on starts on the account Auto would pick, and a hub session's error card says Can't reach the hub. - **Hub fixes:** usage reads no longer fail with 429, a pasted management.html address works, a Claude session on a hub gets its key on Windows, a hub session runs the real `claude` or `codex` even when your shell has a function of that name, parallel launches on one hub no longer break each other, a hub's keys are never sent to a new address (changing it asks for them again), and agents started in your home folder can't read a hub's key files. - **A signed-out account shows in amber:** its sidebar card's numbers (or its logo for Gemini, Cursor and Copilot), the chat box's account mark and the model pill, with a tooltip naming the computer it's signed out on. A computer that stops answering fades its cards instead, and they clear as soon as it reconnects.
### 📂 Sidebar and workspaces
- **A remote computer's project has Move to workspace too,** so it can move into any workspace and back, and a project added with Add Project on a remote computer joins the workspace of the window you added it from instead of Personal. - **Folding a coordinator's threads while one of them is the open chat switches the window to the coordinator's chat,** as a click on its row does. - **Ask Ghostex AI's chats show under Main Hub,** even with the Main Hub extension off, instead of as a project of their own.
### 🧩 Extensions and Settings
- **A click anywhere on a Settings row or card with one switch toggles it,** extension cards included, and Space or Enter toggles a focused row. An installed extension's card opens its page from its name or the Details chevron. - **Workspaces moves to Settings > Extensions > Experimental.** Its switch keeps its value, and while it's off nothing of Workspaces shows. - **The Git extension is retired:** the Store no longer offers it and an installed copy is removed. The header's Commit button and its Git popover are Ghostex's own and stay. - **An extension's dialog can always be closed** with the X on its corner or Escape, so one with no close button of its own no longer stays on screen. - **The Work items extension (0.3.1) leaves the left sidebar:** its Work list there is gone, and the Work button and Work panel stay. - **Settings > Extensions lists the catalog even when one entry can't be read,** and an installed extension it can't read is skipped and reported once.
### 🧭 Agents and coordinators
- **`--body-file -` reads a message from standard input** for `ghostex agents send`, `agents create`, the main coordinator's send and `coordinator start-thread`, so text with backticks or `# Changelog
can go through a quoted heredoc without the shell running it.
### 🪟 Windows
- **An inline page window shrunk to a strip grows back to a usable size,** and a hidden one stays hidden instead of coming back unclickable.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Screen readers and automation tools can press the Work button, sidebar menu rows and a Work card's More actions,** and Needs you rows and Work cards are named after their to-do.
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 11.11.0
## 11.11.0 - 2026-11-19
**Ghostex 11.11.0 is out.** Work items and a Work button for any session, two computers' servers linked with no desktop app, Grok Bot driving your agents, your own update-check times, a focused Interface settings group, and a big round of speed fixes for Windows with many agents.
### 📋 Work items
- **Any session can keep its own work items,** not only coordinators: while Work items is on, a session's to-dos, waits and finished work fill its Work panel, dock rows and cards under a Topic you can rewrite with a click ([#670](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/670)). - **A Work button in the header** opens the Work panel beside the chat, with a count of what waits on you. It shares the spot with Session details, one at a time. - **Needs you cards look like their dock rows:** the title wraps over as many lines as it needs with the answers under it, and a click on a card opens what it points to. A page opens at once. - **`ghostex agents send --with-next` holds a note for the other session's next message,** so a note that needs nothing now never starts a turn by itself ([#670](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/670)). - **The Thread brief extension is now Work items (0.3.0):** turn it on in Settings > Extensions for the Work button and a Work list of every session with work items. Your old briefs move into work items once, the objective becoming the Topic, and an extension's skill is in place only while the extension is on. - **The floating ask panel's text can be selected and copied** with Cmd+C, Edit > Copy or a right-click Copy, and a web address in a to-do's title is a link again.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **A new coordinator starts on the model and effort you last used for a coordinator with that agent,** so you pick it once; Opus 5.5 High is only the very first default, thanks to @sebastianarena ([#658](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/658)). - **A low-end model asks you to confirm** on the first-message card before Start, on the computer and the phone. - **Grok Bot can drive your agents:** `ghostex grokbot connect` links a Ghostex bot in xAI's Grok Bot, so you can ask what your agents are doing and hand out work from its chat, and your agents send you notes through it. Help > Grok Bot has the steps.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Link two computers' servers with no desktop app:** `ghostex computers add <code>` pairs two gxserver computers so their agents can work across them, with each owner approving on the app or a phone ([#674](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/674)). - **Paired computers in Settings > Remote** lists a computer's server links with an Agent access switch and Remove, which ends the link both ways. A connected computer's Edit dialog and the phone have the same ([#674](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/674)). - **A remote session's merged-PR Clean up and Keep chips answer on its own computer,** and the where pill offers Open folder only for a session on this computer.
### 🪟 Windows
- **Many agents no longer bog Windows down:** far fewer wmx.exe processes (about 20 a minute instead of 47 with six agents), session lists keep working when Windows' session list stops answering, and Git reads, paste checks, status line refreshes and the server's database share the work instead of piling up ([#666](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/666)). - **Fixed a crash when a window closed while other work was queued,** and a Windows crash report now names the panic that started it ([#675](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/675)). - **Restored agent terminals no longer start Windows PowerShell 5.1,** and a restored agent whose exact resume fails runs its saved fallback ([#666](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/666)). - **An inline page's ⋯ menu shows over its page window.** - **A cua-driver update refreshes the skill your WSL agents read.**
### 💬 Chat
- **A Codex model or effort pick waits for Codex's turn to end,** so the message behind it is never typed into the running turn, and a pick that meets a busy agent backs off instead of retrying over and over ([#666](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/666)). - **Claude rewinds work again on Claude Code 2.1.326 and later,** instead of timing out at the confirmation step. - **An idle coordinator no longer keeps gxserver busy re-reading its transcript** ([#668](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/668)), and renaming or closing a session rebuilds only the chat history that names it. - **`ghostex` commands find their session from a sandboxed Codex,** so Needs you and private secret cards work there, and saving an automation refuses a model its agent doesn't have ([#669](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/669)). - **A question tag pill opens its page at once,** like the page card's Open.
### ⚙️ Settings
- **Choose how often Ghostex checks for updates:** a Checking for updates fold on Settings > Updates sets Ghostex, Agents, Tools and Extensions to every 15 minutes, 30 minutes, hour (the default) or day, or Only on Check now. Agents you turned off are never probed ([#673](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/673)). - **Interface is four focused pages** under a new Interface group in the Settings sidebar: Themes, Text & Fonts, Size & Zoom, and Window & Layout. Every setting keeps its value. - **A theme colour row you haven't set shows the colour it paints now,** ready to adjust from there. - **Read live status from Claude Code and Cursor** is a switch under Settings > Agents > Advanced, on by default, and Use agent hooks moves there too. Claude's status row stays clean, and outside Ghostex the helper only runs your own status line. - **Floating Capture is an experimental extension:** turn it on in Settings > Extensions > Experimental. If you had the floating button on, it stays on. - **Ghostex never overwrites an agent's config it can't read,** keeps its links and file permissions, and Uninstall all carries on past one it can't change.
### 📂 Sidebar
- **A sessions group's menu has Ungroup,** which removes the group and keeps its sessions open, and a new group opens its name for renaming. - **Close Group, Remove GBot, Remove Department and Destroy Box ask in Ghostex's own dialog.**
### 📱 On the phone
- **The Work sheet shows its Topic,** and a tap rewrites it. - **Paired computers** in a computer's settings, with each server link's Agent access switch and Remove ([#674](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/674)).
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Linux: the picture, wallpaper, Live or video behind the glass draws again** on X11 and Wayland ([#667](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/667)). - **Linux: quitting Ghostex with a web page open no longer leaves a "process crashed" notice** from its graphics helper. - **Live glass shows its default animation** (Aurora in dark mode, Drift in light) when you never picked a style, instead of nothing. - **Files: Cmd+click or Option+click on a link in a Markdown table cell opens it,** and a plain click still edits the cell ([#671](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/671)). - **Settings and the window stay responsive while Ghostex checks for updates,** and windows redraw only when what the Updates status shows changed. - **macOS: writes into ignored folders no longer make Ghostex re-read a project's Git state** ([#666](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/666)). - **The dictation waveform follows how loudly you speak,** on the computer and the phone.
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 11.10.0
## 11.10.0 - 2026-11-18
**Ghostex 11.10.0 is out.** Pick any model and effort before a new coordinator starts, a where pill above the chat box, colour pickers and sliders for every theme colour, popups with tabs in their title bar, a calmer Workers list, and a long list of fixes from your reports.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **A new coordinator's first message waits for you:** it sits in the chat box as a card with Show all, Edit and Start, so you can change the model and effort in the agent first. Typing a request and pressing Enter starts it with your request queued behind. - **Any model can run a coordinator,** Antigravity's Orchestrator (Argon) included. The model picker only adds a quiet "You might get a degraded experience." on low-end picks ([#665](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/665)). - **The Workers list reads at a glance:** every worker is two lines, its title and what it's doing (Building, Testing, Editing files) with its tool calls and changed files. Hover a worker to see its work item's latest line. - **Fewer "ok" replies:** notes that only inform wait for your next message, and a bare "ok" after a thread's report is hidden. - **Autopilot:** read-only threads never wait on it, a switch lets read-only threads leave plan mode, and the supervisor gets regular check-ups and its own Open supervisor row. - **Sandboxed Codex sessions can run `ghostex` commands,** with everything else still sandboxed, and the command finds its session even when Codex hides Ghostex's variables ([#655](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/655)). - **Automations can set the model and effort their runs start on,** a run whose prompt never arrives ends on its own instead of blocking every later run, and saving refuses fields it doesn't know ([#656](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/656), [#662](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/662)).
### 💬 Chat
- **A where pill above the chat box** shows the project, branch and the computer's own icon. Click it for the details: click any row to copy it, or use Copy path and Open folder. The header leaves the project out while the pill shows it. - **Long messages are sent instead of held forever** when they need more rows than Claude Code's or Codex's input box shows ([#654](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/654)). - **Typing meant for a private secret card can never land in the chat box,** even if you click the chat box or a second card opens while you type ([#648](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/648)). - **The chat no longer misses a turn** the terminal shows, with OMP and with Codex when hooks are off ([#649](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/649), [#650](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/650)). - **Switching to Chat while Claude's question is open** no longer hangs and fails ([#661](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/661)). - **The chat jumps back to its end when you send,** thanks to @sebastianarena ([#657](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/657)). - **Dismiss is quiet:** it no longer sends the agent a message, and finished items in the dock and finished-work cards offer Mark as read. - **Quiet View folds every message to a thread** into its summary line, and its tool call and changed-file counts no longer double up. - **Answered forms look calmer,** and a picture in a reply box no longer touches its label. - **Paste in terminal and Run work on the first click** when the Commands panel is closed.
### 🎨 Look and feel
- **Every theme colour has a colour picker and a slider,** and a new Chat colours group leads with your own message bubble, with a See-through slider and a live preview. Links, pill dots and code blocks follow your theme colours, and the page says which colours a gallery theme set. - **Popup windows have tabs in their title bar,** even with one tab. Drag tabs to combine, split or pull them out, the window has the main window's glass, and expand and shrink take effect right away. - **Menus are frosted:** the notifications menu blurs what's behind it, and a page's right-click menu closes when you click away or press Escape. - **A signed-out account shows a calm card** with one sentence and a Reconnect button, instead of a yellow box.
### 📂 Sidebar
- **Drag projects from other computers into any order** in the one list and in Spaces, and the order sticks. - **Sort sessions by Recent, Alphabetical or Created,** while pinned sessions keep your order, thanks to @sebastianarena ([#660](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/660)). - **The session menu reads Rename, Pin, Popout,** Copy ID tops the Copy menu, and Move to New Group is shorter. - **Open Folder says why** when a project's drive isn't connected or its folder is gone, instead of doing nothing. - **A project on one computer shows its machine icon as a label,** and Remove Active projects explains itself in an (i) tooltip. - **Update all only updates the items it lists.**
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Connect a Computer no longer waits on SSH,** and Ghostex never turns on SSH or installs OpenSSH by itself. On Linux, Turn on SSH shows your distro's install command with Copy, plus an Install button ([#663](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/663)). - **A session link for another computer opens there,** with no stray "Couldn't open it". - **CLIProxyAPI hubs** can be added in Settings > Accounts once you turn on the CLIProxyAPI extension: see their accounts' usage and start sessions on the hub. - **The help explains working across computers:** threads and agents on other computers, and handing a conversation over.
### 👤 Accounts
- **A new session no longer starts on an account that's full only for another model,** and Claude sessions get a name even when Claude doesn't write one ([#664](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/664)). - **Claude's idle compaction settings reach Claude only once you change them in Ghostex,** thanks to @sebastianarena ([#659](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/659)). - **A finished Claude session stays finished** after its idle compaction, with no false "stalled" nudge.
### 📱 On the phone
- **Swipe between Spaces** on the sessions list, and the same where pill, first-message card, two-line Workers rows and Mark as read as the computer. - **The private secret card keeps the keyboard** while it's open. - **Autopilot settings** put Advanced above the Log, with the read-only switch and Open supervisor.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Fixed a crash when changing a setting after Ghostex updated its environment,** and crash reports now carry what was on screen, the last few app events and the exact build ([#653](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/653)). - **Files opens links that point outside the project,** and Option-click opens a linked file in your default app ([#645](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/645)). - **Linux updates show the command to run,** with Copy and the release page. - **The macOS terminal library is built optimized,** so the terminal is faster and lighter. - **A Codex effort written with spaces is replaced, not doubled,** thanks to @sebastianarena.
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 11.9.0
## 11.9.0 - 2026-11-17
**Ghostex 11.9.0 is out.** Go back to the version you had in one click, report a crash in one click, sessions in their own window, plain approval cards, a setup row for Claude Swap and Codex Swap, and every release now passes a smoke test on macOS before it ships.
### 🛟 Safer updates
- **Go back to the version you had:** every update keeps the previous version, and Settings > Updates offers "Go back to <version>" any time something feels off. On deb and rpm installs it gives the one command that installs the older package. - **If a new version keeps crashing,** Ghostex says so the next time it opens and offers Try again or Go back, and the update window says where to go back. - **Report a crash in one click:** after a crash, the next open shows what happened, exactly what would be sent (version, system, where it crashed, recent log lines, with private details removed) and one Send report button. The same crash from many people lands on one issue so it gets fixed faster. - **Every release is now smoke tested on macOS before it ships:** chats and coordinators with Claude and Codex, the terminal, the browser, typing everywhere, model changes and the fixes for recent crashes.
### 🪟 Work area
- **Open a chat or terminal session in its own window** from its right-click menu, the work area header, the split-pane grip, the Pop Out Pane hotkey or Option-click. Pin keeps it on top and closing it brings the session back ([#641](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/641)). - **Page windows keep their frosted glass on macOS** when the desktop picture file is gone, as with some live wallpaper apps. - **Hidden projects and hidden collections no longer add dots** to their Space or computer tab, unless Show hidden is on.
### 👤 Accounts
- **A setup row at the top of Settings > Accounts** offers to install Claude Swap or Codex Swap when your saved accounts need it, shows the install, and on a failure says why with Try again and Copy details. Accounts that wait for it say "Needs Claude Swap". - **Disabled accounts sit at the bottom** of the Claude and Codex lists, with the ones you use and the ones that need a sign-in on top. - **A Claude session whose login expired moves to another ready account by itself,** and that account is marked for sign-in. - **Codex rate-limit resets work again.**
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Approval cards ask one plain question,** like "Let Office PC connect to MacBook?", with the words to check in big boxes and just Deny and Approve. Touch ID asks the same question. - **A computer without a screen pairs from its terminal:** `ghostex computer-code` shows the code right away and says where to approve, and the approval shows as a card in your other Ghostex apps instead of on that computer's screen. - **Connected computers never ask you for approvals on their own;** only something you do asks, once, and approvals you gave carry over restarts. - **Connect a computer has Code, Headless server and SSH details tabs,** and says why it can't show a code instead of spinning. - **A coordinator can start on another computer,** with its project and account picked on the agent step. - **Windows: Ghostex moves to a free port when Windows reserves its usual one,** and your other computers follow it ([#639](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/639)). - **A plain folder never merges with another computer's project just by its name.**
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **A long one-line message reaches Claude Code on a short terminal,** and a message never stays stuck as sending ([#643](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/643)). - **Changing the model or effort no longer leaves stray /model or /effort text in Claude's or Codex's input box.** - **Update all never installs Hex by itself;** it shows under Not installed with its own Install button ([#644](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/644)), thanks to @franklinselva. - **Links, code and bold text show inside Markdown table cells** in the Files viewer ([#645](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/645)). - **A paste into the terminal that can't be delivered says why** instead of doing nothing. - **Snoozed questions fold into one Snoozed row** above the chat box. - **No error dialogs while Ghostex's server starts or restarts,** and a restart sends far fewer updates. - **The sidebar shows its settled look from the first frame** at launch. - **Ghostex skills work as slash commands in Claude sessions you start yourself,** and only Ghostex's own sessions use them on their own. - **Linux (Omarchy): the usage pop-up, header dropdowns and the links card stay open** while you use them. - **Windows: header dropdowns fit their window** at fractional scales. - **A home folder project shows a house and a drive shows a drive,** never an app's icon from inside it. - **Themes recolour the notifications menu and the Settings chat preview.** - **`ghostex page retire` works again.**
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 11.8.2
## 11.8.2 - 2026-11-16
**Ghostex 11.8.2 is out.** It fixes the Mac app quitting when a chat shows a one-click answer, including on every launch for some people.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **macOS: Ghostex no longer quits when you open a chat that ends with one-click answer buttons,** which for some people happened on every launch, thanks to @nadzifal, @NexiaMoe and @WangAxerold. - **Ghostex's notes reach a coordinator as their own message,** and the chat hides them however they arrive, so a coordinator's reply is no longer lost behind one, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **A coordinator's right-click menu groups its settings under one Coordinator row,** as the phone's long-press menu does. - **A new chat in an existing worktree on another computer opens in Chat,** not as a terminal or an empty pane.

# Ghostex 11.7.1
## 11.7.1 - 2026-11-15
**Ghostex 11.7.1 is out.** Sessions no longer wake up and spend your usage on their own after a usage limit or a restart, long chats are compacted before they carry on, workers under a coordinator stop sending you notifications, the project picker and the browser bar show each computer's own logo, sidebar extensions arrive, and Settings search finds only real matches.
### 🔋 Usage after a limit or a restart
- **Sessions stay put after a usage limit:** with Switch accounts and no saved account, a session at its limit stays stopped and nothing is typed into it. After a restart, a limit wait asks "Continue after the limit reset?" with Continue and Not now, and while it waits a card shows the time and a Stop button. A message Ghostex sends by itself now says so (#608). - **Threads stopped by a restart wait for you:** a coordinator's threads that were cut off when Ghostex closed show a red dot ("Stopped when Ghostex closed"), and the coordinator shows one card with Carry on and Not now. Turn on Resume sessions after a restart to let them carry on by themselves (#608). - **Compact first, save usage:** the Continue and Carry on cards have a Compact first box, ticked for chats above the size in Settings > Agents > Claude Code > Compact chats above (200K by default), so a long chat is summarised before it re-reads everything after a break. Claude, Codex, Grok and Cursor. - **Workers are compacted before their coordinator returns:** when a coordinator messages a thread whose prompt cache has expired and whose chat is above that size, Ghostex compacts it first, then delivers the message. Turn it off with Compact workers before a coordinator returns to them.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Workers stop notifying you:** a coordinator's thread that finishes, asks a question, gets stuck or ends on an error tells its coordinator instead of you, and only shows its red or pink dot. Approvals and blocked accounts still reach you, and a worker's approval opens on the coordinator. Settings > Notifications > Workers (Off, Silent or Sound) brings them back. On the computer and the phone. - **A clearer Workers popover:** running work and threads that need you come first, finished ones fold into one line, and each row shows the agent's logo, a two-line preview and its work item. - **Threads named in the chat look calmer:** a thread's name is text with a faint dotted underline, no frame, with a dot only while it works or needs you, in messages, on Message from and to cards and in the chat box. Clicking a name for another computer's session opens it there.
### 🖥️ Computers
- **Each computer wears its own logo:** pick Apple, Windows, Tux, Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch or Red Hat as a computer's icon, or let it show its own system's logo; every computer you connect sees the same icon. - **A new project picker:** each project is one line with its own icon (or its letter on a coloured tile), and its computers sit in columns as their logos, with a computer that isn't connected shown faint. The browser's address bar also shows only the logo of the computer a page loads from, with its name on hover. - **Remote connections when two computers share an id:** Ghostex now tells this computer apart from a remote that happens to share its short server id, and says why agents can't reach it, thanks to @banozz0.
### 🧩 Extensions
- **Sidebar extensions:** an extension can add its own mode beside Bots, sections above or below the projects, a side panel and its own pages, and can ship an agent skill you choose to install with it. - **The Store shows more before you install:** each extension's real icon, README and changelog, and a GitHub link for community extensions. Store pages load faster.
### 🐧 Linux and Windows
